RegistrationInfo.Description: W365 thin client IDLE LOGOFF (SCRIPT-FREE, Oct 13 2026): log off the local IoT session after the device sits untouched for 60 minutes - the awake-but-abandoned case the event triggers cannot see. SINGLE IdleTrigger; its duration is carried in Settings/IdleSettings (Duration PT1H, WaitTimeout PT1H). This is a SEPARATE task from W365-Logoff-YOLO-AllTriggers on purpose: IdleSettings is global to a task, so putting the 60-minute Duration on the event task would gate its wake/disconnect triggers behind a 60-minute idle condition as well. StopOnIdleEnd stays false (the rwinsta action is instant; a returning user mid-action is not a concern). Runs as LOCAL SYSTEM, same as the rest of the package.
